Delete your AdultingOS account

You can delete your account in the app (Profile → Privacy and security → Delete my account). If you can't use the app, use this page.

What happens

Your account, tasks, bills, payments, documents, subscriptions, settings, achievements, consent history and Ask Adu conversations are permanently deleted. We keep a record that a deletion happened (without your identity) and the text of feedback you sent, with your identity removed. Backups are overwritten within 30 days.

1. Confirm it's you

Enter the e-mail address of your AdultingOS account. We'll send a sign-in link to prove you own it.

Check your inbox and open the link on this device. It brings you back here.
